agent_notes: The NIRF 2025 Engineering listing contains the exact assigned institution name with Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, confirming the government-directory prerequisite and campus-city match.

Normal TLS verification for the expected NIRF and bncet.ac.in hosts failed with the proxy's exact self-signed-certificate-in-chain error; public GET requests then used curl --insecure after confirming the expected hostnames.

The official site has a catalogue-completeness conflict: the current-linked 2024 brochure lists B.Tech Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, five Polytechnic families, and MBA tracks, while the older official Courses & Eligibility PDF (last modified 2022) lists a different set including Biotechnology, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering (Production). The official AI & ML / DS department page is newer than that admissions PDF but does not provide a complete programme/eligibility table. The record is therefore manual_review and course_catalogue_status is partial_official_website; the courses above are the latest brochure-listed BNCET programme families, with null eligibility where no exact current official statement was found.

Pharmacy entries were excluded because the official brochure separately identifies B.N. College of Pharmacy (BNCP), Lucknow, rather than B.N. College of Engineering and Technology. The brochure labels BCA and BBA as upcoming courses, so they were excluded as not active offerings. Faculty PhD references were not treated as doctoral programmes.

Career mappings use the read-only career_path.db tree. Exact nodes were used where available; Data Science, standalone Artificial Intelligence, postgraduate branches, diploma branches, and MBA use clearly labelled nearest-parent or closest-specialization mappings.
The official brochure describes BNCET as part of B.N.G.I./Baij Nath Charitable and Educational Trust; this observation was not used to alter the supplied institution_context institution_type.
